about: Final-score brief for the V7 film, locked to the founder's measured voice (the master clock). The review cut plays a six-stem score synthesized in-project (scripts/make-score-v7.py) that follows this brief.

deliverable.preferred: six stems, WAV 48 kHz 24-bit stereo, sample-accurate at 0.000 s, each the film's full length: public/music/final/v7/bed.wav (atmospheric bed: low drone, air, distant shimmer), public/music/final/v7/pulse.wav (low cinematic pulse: soft kick, sub, analog bass), public/music/final/v7/harmony.wav (warm harmonic texture: detuned analog pads, strings-like), public/music/final/v7/rhythm.wav (technical rhythmic layer: plucked 16ths, soft ticks), public/music/final/v7/texture.wav (transition textures: reverse swells, digital micro-texture, the permission tone), public/music/final/v7/resolve.wav (emotional resolution: soft mallet / bell motifs)
deliverable.alternative: one mixed score at public/music/final/v7/score.wav (e.g. Eleven Music; the stems are then muted)
deliverable.end: the music almost stops for 'NavisLabs.', a very soft harmonic tail under the tagline, silence from 124.31 s
deliverable.loudness: score alone about −18 to −20 LUFS integrated, true peak ≤ −1 dBTP; the film applies the keyframed curves (−6 dB under every line, −11 dB under the key lines, controlled dips)

style: Premium cinematic AI-infrastructure score: organic analog synth texture, warm low end, a subtle pulse, restrained percussion, an evolving harmonic bed, technical micro-textures and an emotional final resolution. No EDM, cyberpunk, trailer braams, cheesy piano, corporate stock or generic motivational music. The founder's voice always wins.

arc.brief: almost no music, never dead: a low atmosphere under the contradiction; scattered high fragments as the systems appear; heavier on 'by hand'; held on 'without it'; a breath, then a reverse swell into 'Navis'
the first wow: on 'Navis' the music opens — warm harmonic bloom, deep pulse, small digital texture; the pipeline builds layer by layer and pulls back on 'next'
the Navis App: warm, intelligent, half-time; drops back to a controlled breath on 'A person decides.', returns on 'Then the company acts.'
Navis Developer: precise 16th-note rhythm, soft kick, analog bass; thins under the key lines; slows for the permission check with a low tonal shift on DENIED; resolves slightly as the run completes
solo → team → company: from one voice to the full ensemble; the voice alone carries 'Same facts. Same sources. Same freshness.'; lift on 'One understanding.', resolution on 'Two ways in.'
slow, deep, warm, wide; no rhythm; rises in the pause after 'Tools change.'; no crescendo
everything almost stops for 'NavisLabs.'; logo in near-silence; a very soft harmonic tail under the tagline; then silence
